mostWorthwhile.text: Following glucose into glycogen and back into blood was most worthwhile: the sequence connects liver storage to supplying tissues between meals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the explicitly named portal-vessel slot was straightforward but offered little explanation beyond the structural connection.

surprise.text: The final model connects digestion to nerves and lymph as well as blood, although it leaves those connections largely unexplained.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, but adding a separate Blood transport item felt somewhat mechanical: blood was already present beside the liver cells.

continue.text: I would continue to see how further systems connect, especially if their functions are explained as clearly as liver glucose storage and release.
